policy: Cited reported direct equity percentages belong to their individual source period and do not imply ultimate beneficial control. Project actor mentions denote reported participation, NOT equity. Public-float and treasury aggregates must not become legal entities. Validate contemporary status against source.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Freeport Indonesia
ownership_profiles.control_note: FCX is described as operating shareholder with rights to appoint a majority of members of the operating committee. Economic equity majority and operational governance differ.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: PT IPMM was reported 100% MIND ID-owned at 31 December 2025, yielding a 51.24% MIND ID group position. This is a corporate equity chain, not an individually verified beneficial owner.

shareholders.name: PT Indonesia Papua Metal Dan Mineral (PT IPMM)

ownership_profiles.name: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (INCO)
ownership_profiles.control_note: Joint control disclosed by company; not inferred from simple ownership threshold.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: Vale states MIND ID and Vale Canada exercise joint control. A 34% largest shareholding is not sole control. Company identifies Vale Canada as belonging to Vale Base Metals.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM)
ownership_profiles.control_note: MIND ID direct controlling shareholder in reported period; state strategic rights are a separate layer.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: ANTAM reports MIND ID as immediate parent and Danantara as ultimate parent incorporated in Indonesia, controlled by the Republic of Indonesia. A separate Series A Dwiwarna state share must not be confused with Series B economic percentages.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park
ownership_profiles.control_note: Direct percentages disclosed; cannot infer a single controlling natural person, governance rights or ultimate voting control without additional evidence.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: The IMIP corporate FAQ lists three direct shareholders. The ultimate owners of intermediate companies and ultimate natural-person beneficial owners are NOT established by this statement.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Smelting (Gresik)
ownership_profiles.control_note: FCX states Mitsubishi Materials operates PT Smelting facilities despite holding a 34% stake.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: PT Freeport Indonesia is majority shareholder in PT Smelting. Its own shareholder chain is separately documented under PTFI; look-through arithmetic does not automatically translate to operating control.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Kolaka Nickel Indonesia (KNI)
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: Vale identifies PT KNI as the HPAL project venture with Vale, Huayou and Ford. No current ownership percentages are supplied in the selected project disclosure; partner participation does not determine equity percentage.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA)
ownership_profiles.control_note: Majority corporate ownership through MIND ID; direct control rights and operational authorizations are not interchangeable.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: MIND ID is the majority Series B holder. The Republic of Indonesia additionally holds five Series A Dwiwarna shares; those special shares are a separate rights class and cannot be measured by percentage alone.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Pertamina Hulu Indonesia (PHI)
ownership_profiles.control_note: PHE is PHI's disclosed controlling shareholder at the entity level; PHI subsidiary PSC operational rights must be checked at asset-specific level.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: PHI's direct equity holders are PHE and Pertamina Pedeve. The group's ultimate institutional ownership and legal special rights require separate parent-level disclosures.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM)
ownership_profiles.control_note: Distinguish Danantara's economic equity interests, the state Dwiwarna share, Telkom corporate governance and Telkom subsidiary-level data-center JV shareholdings.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: The September 2025 Telkom public disclosure lists PT Danantara Asset Management holding 52.09% of Series B shares and the Republic of Indonesia holding one Series A Dwiwarna special-rights share.

ownership_profiles.name: Abadi LNG / Masela PSC consortium
ownership_profiles.control_note: INPEX Masela is the PSC operator. SKK Migas supervision, field development approvals, project contractors and equity governance are different powers.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: 65/20/15 are upstream Masela Production Sharing Contract (PSC) participating interests, NOT share ownership in a single Indonesian incorporated company. Each contractor's corporate parent chain requires separate filings.

ownership_profiles.name: Tangguh LNG PSC consortium (UCC investment)
ownership_profiles.control_note: bp is PSC operator with 40.22% working/participating interest; operational designation is not direct share majority.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: Disclosed percentages are Tangguh PSC participating interests. The controlling owners of each consortium SPV require separate legal-entity tracing, not mechanical attribution to individuals.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN)
ownership_profiles.control_note: Bayan officially identifies Low Tuck Kwong as a primary and controlling shareholder with 40.22% voting shares. Do not automatically attribute Elaine Low's holdings to him or claim a 72.22% sole block.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: Bayan directly identifies Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low among shareholders. PT Sumber Suryadaya Prima is separately recorded as a 10% corporate shareholder; its shareholder chain has not been established in this dossier.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI)
ownership_profiles.control_note: Largest disclosed direct corporate holder is PT Adaro Strategic. Operational control, contractual rights and beneficial ownership cannot be inferred solely from percentage.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: Listed direct holding percentages are from PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia; the aggregated remainder is calculated as 100% minus the three individually listed large shareholders, including public holders and small management stakes. It must not be interpreted as a single legal shareholder. Ownership up the PT Adaro Strategic chain requires entity-by-entity verification.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (MEDC)
ownership_profiles.control_note: Majority shareholding by PT Medco Daya Abadi Lestari. Subsidiary PSC operators and project financing arrangements must be evaluated independently from holding-company voting rights.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: The annual report lists PT Medco Daya Abadi Lestari as majority shareholder and Diamond Bridge Pte. Ltd. as a major shareholder. The aggregated remainder is not a legal shareholder. Corporate and natural-person ownership above these entities must be traced from primary filings.

ownership_profiles.name: Equinix–Astra Indonesia data center joint venture (JK1)
ownership_profiles.control_note: Equinix is the majority equity holder in the publicly announced JV. The physical JK1 facility was inaugurated 15 May 2025, but ownership percentages were disclosed at JV formation, not reconfirmed as of 2026.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: JV direct economic equity at 2023 formation was 75/25; verify current local legal entity, cap table and amendments before asserting this remains unchanged in October 2026. Astra itself reports Jardine Cycle & Carriage as its 50.11% shareholder in 2025.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII)
ownership_profiles.control_note: Jardine Cycle & Carriage direct corporate majority in Astra; this does not itself specify control of each Astra investee or subsidiary.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: Astra's corporate owner Jardine Cycle & Carriage holds a 50.11% majority. Its upstream corporate group chain needs separate filings before assigning natural-person ownership. Its 25% JK1 JV interest is a different layer.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Chandra Asri Alkali (CAA) — CA-EDC project developer
ownership_profiles.control_note: CAA is identified as the operating project developer, but the investment agreement does not itself prove changes in voting control or closing of new share allotments.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: Danantara identifies PT Chandra Asri Alkali as the subsidiary project company of Chandra Asri Group. A 3 March 2026 Conditional Share Subscription Agreement proposed aggregate Danantara + INA participation of US$200m; the release does not specify individual contributions, direct issued share percentages, or whether conditions were completed.

ownership_profiles.name: PT Daya Energi Bersih Nusantara (Denera) — Danantara WtE platform
ownership_profiles.control_note: DIM is the stated sponsoring platform. Programmatic oversight does not prove Denera owns 100% of each PSEL project or controls future privately selected partners.
ownership_profiles.ownership_chain_note: Danantara's 17 September 2026 official release describes Denera as established under DIM as the national waste-to-energy development and coordination platform. Precise direct shareholding percentages and any project-specific SPV shares are not disclosed in that statement.
